description: The actions of the collision studio (/collision-studio) for one bound model of a game: compare every method with its score and reason, save the method and budgets the game wants in its passport (deviations only, never a copy of the passport), or remove them. Then run gripforge_collision_build with game (and server: true) to make the collision again. 0 credits.

action.description: compare: make the model with each method (box, compound, convex, convex_decomposition, trimesh) and give parts, score and reason — nothing saved, no AI advice. save: write the game's section in its asset_passports (only the keys that differ from the global passport). reset: remove it, the passport rules again.

section.description: kits.collision keys of the game for this model: shape, usage, mobile, maxParts, maxHullPoints, maxTriangles, resolution, small.

slot.description: The slot of the bound model, as gripforge_collision_build with game lists it.

name: gripforge_collision_passport
title: Compare, force or reset the collision method of one model of a game
